verified: edh-next-90 review (top-rank part 6, EDHREC top 20,000), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings (2020-11-10: you may activate it by sacrificing it and a green creature even if it became nongreen; you can't sacrifice more creatures) and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: CR 701.21a, 118.3, 602.2b: the cost is {G}, {T} and the sacrifice of the object itself and of one OTHER green creature (the second part is `other`, two parts; the source is paid first so it is never the other creature); the search is a plain library search for a green creature card put onto the battlefield, then the shuffle.

edh-next-90 review (top-rank part 6, EDHREC top 20,000), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall ruling (2021-11-19: it can be discarded only by a rule or effect) and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: CR 701.9a, 603.1, 603.12, 113.6k: the spell returns a creature card from the graveyard to the battlefield; the second ability triggers from the graveyard (or exile, under madness-like replacements) when the card is discarded, its controller may pay {B}, and the reflexive trigger returns a creature card from the graveyard to the hand. A fixed mana payment on resolution keeps the trigger automated (parser/lower/trigger-zone.ts).

edh-next-90 review (top-rank part 6, EDHREC top 20,000), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings (2020-06-23) and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: CR 118.3, 701.9a, 201.2, 121.4: the cost discards exactly three cards of the hand, no two with the same name (cost part discard.distinctNames, rules/cost-pick.ts); five cards are drawn; the replacement of a draw from an empty library by five +1/+1 counters was already automated.

edh-next-90 review (top-rank part 6, EDHREC top 20,000), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall ruling (2011-09-22: the land may still go to the hand when a creature died) and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: CR 701.23a, 614.15, 608.2c, 608.2d, 400.7: the found land is put into the hand unless its controller chooses (a may) to put it onto the battlefield, which is allowed only if a creature died this turn (rid.edhn90.instead.mayPutThatCardBattlefield.if; the move to the hand is guarded by `did not`).

edh-next-90 review (top-rank part 6, EDHREC top 20,000), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings (2007-05-01: a kicked Molten Disaster has split second as long as it is on the stack; 2024-11-08 kicker) and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: CR 702.61a, 702.33d, 113.6, 611.3a: a static ability of the spell itself that works on the stack only, conditional on `wasCast kicked`, adding the keyword split second (sta.edhn90.self.splitSecond.if); the damage is X to each creature without flying and each player.

edh-next-90 review (top-rank part 6, EDHREC top 20,000), by hand against the Oracle text and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: CR 702.29a, 702.29f, 603.4, 608.2b: the enter trigger (intervening if you cast it) returns any number of target permanent cards with cycling or typecycling from your graveyard to the battlefield; "cycling abilities" is the same keyword filter as "a cycling ability" (parser/holes/filter.ts).
